title: This baby shark bakes cookies and ruins a kitchen
description: Jeff the Land Shark tries his hand at baking, then goes full travel influencer. Chaos ensues.
hook_note: A tiny shark in a chef's hat staring down a lump of dough is instantly disarming and funny.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: This is Jeff the Land Shark, and today the little menace has decided he's a baker.
